name: Koi no Hashi
source:
There is a mysterious bridge where you can share feelings by conveying thoughts. This romantic place becomes known as a place where god lives. Another boy and another girl come to the bridge in search for love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一座神秘的桥，可以传递思想，分享感情。这个浪漫的地方被称为神居住的地方。另一个男孩和另一个女孩来到桥上寻找爱情。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
